task.pr_title: SQL: Improve ROUND and TRUNCATE to better manage Long values and big Doubles

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: the `ROUND` docs state that "The returned numeric data type is the same as the data type of numeric_exp." This property does no longer hold with the fallback to double arithmetic.

evidence.thread_resolution: luigidellaquila: Yeah, it didn't hold even before this change (it always returned double), but it's a good moment to fix it 👍
